==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use this skill on enemies that are knocked down; they may occasionally queue this skill on enemies who are just about to recover from being knocked down, resulting in the skill undergoing full cooldown.

== Notes ==
* This skill works well with the four-second knock downs caused by [[Backbreaker]].
* Combined with a skill that improves [[attack speed]] by 33%, this attack can hit four times every three seconds (the length of a standard knock down with [[Stonefist Insignia]]).

== Trivia ==
* The warrior in the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[warrior Canthan armor|Canthan Armor]].
* The weapon in the icon appears to be a [[Spiked Club]].
